entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: on I.A. No.20638/2022, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of the appellant.

The appellant has been convicted by the trial Court under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2)(I) of IPC and sentenced to R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, R.I for 3 years with fine of Rs.1000/- and R.I for 1 years with fine of Rs.3000/- respectively, with default stipulations.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the appellant for the aforesaid offences.
The appellant is in jail since 07.09.2022 and disposal of this appeal would take considerable time, hence, jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate has opposed the application.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case; statement of the prosecutrix and medical evidence, this Court is of the opinion that the appellant is not entitled for the benefit of suspension of sentence.
